## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first. Dispositions:

- **DF-S1.24-1 (F)** — progress note appended (2026-09-22): the engine half
  lands here — `register`/`expand`/`open`/`next`/`claim`/`launch`/`settle`/
  `pause`/`resume`/`close` executable over `Store` + `LabDocs`. The
  estimator-kernel ops (S3.4c), results store (S3.4b), compatibility
  consumers (S5.4) and debt manager (S6.1b) stay OPEN.
- **DF-S1.24-2 (V)** — progress note appended (2026-09-22): a registered
  `ExperimentSpec` expands to a `CellPlan` and both exemplars execute to a
  completed `close` with `budget_match` re-checks. Results rows (S3.4b) and
  the real foreign-manifest import (GATE-G2 `benchmarkSet`) stay OPEN.
- **OQ-363** — stays OPEN under ADR-0213's interim rule: the `iso_cost`
  companion arm duplicates subject runs rather than sharing them across
  MatchSpecs (the `control-strategy-family-v1` exemplar exercises this —
  5 arms × tasks × replicates as distinct subject runs). AC-R-2.10.3-9's
  run-sharing half is conditionally deferred to the OQ-363 ruling.
- No rows closed; no rows deleted; no new rows opened.

## Resumed-run note
Continued an interrupted worker's tree (commits `bd90368` scaffold +
`0afa453` engine/exemplars/embed wiring). Kept on merit after inspection;
the continuation then fixed the settlement semantics (`oracle_failure` had
been folded into the infrastructure-retry branch — it now marks
`regrade`, never re-runs; `cancelled{principal|parent}` is final
regardless of `on_cancel`), made the `interleaved*` orders explicitly
task-blocked/arm-interleaved, added the E-3/E-4 close-time records
(`utilization`, `under_utilised`, `budget_match`, `na_cells`), the
E-1 enforcement/`budget_relevant` register checks, `C-LCD-5`, and the
regression battery.

## Evidence report

- `hh-experiment` — 29 engine tests: the full lifecycle
  (register→expand→open→next→claim→launch→settle→pause/resume→close),
  the register refusal corpus, exactly-once settle + idempotent replay,
  claim TTL/WouldBlock, launch `InsufficientBudget` replannable,
  kill-point recovery KP-E1…E5, pause gating, exemplar sweeps at
  Stage-3 size (30-plan compaction family; 50-plan control-strategy
  family with the `iso_cost` companion), plus the review battery:
  `oracle_failure_marks_regrade_never_reruns` (no `run_replanned`, the
  `regrade` member set, `next` never re-dispatches),
  `cancelled_by_principal_is_final_under_replan_policy`
  (principal-final + operator-replans under `on_cancel = replan`),
  `interleaved_order_is_task_blocked_arm_interleaved` (two contiguous
  task blocks, rep-major, both arms per round),
  `under_utilised_and_budget_match_recheck_at_close` (median-ppm floor
  annotation + `imbalanced` at tolerance 0),
  `partial_close_reports_not_run_cells`, and
  `infra_retry_lands_settled_excluded_replanned_in_order`.
- `hh-lab` — register refusal battery extended:
  `register_refuses_match_spec_omitting_differing_budget_relevant_param`
  (AC-R-2.10.2-12 / T-LCD-14 — differing `budget_relevant` param whose
  `affects` dim is unlisted ⇒ `UnmatchedBudget`; covered registers;
  identical binding registers) and
  `register_refuses_matched_cap_dim_not_enforced_on_every_arm`
  (E-1/CF-350 — advisory `budget_enforcement` on a matched dim ⇒
  `IncommensurableMatch`).
- `hh-eval` — `compare_refuses_cross_mode_match` (CF-334 — `matched_cap`
  vs `iso_cost` ⇒ `IncommensurableMatch{MixedMatchModes}`).
- `hh-assembly` — `registry_operation_bound_as_tool_capability_refuses`
  (AC-R-2.10.2-6 — `C-LCD-5` at stage 7; catalog-bound tool silent).
- `hh-embed` — `lab.experiment.*` params carry the resolver material
  (`budget_enforcement`, `budget_relevant_params` added); absent
  resolvers defer per the engine contract.
- `registry_snapshot_id` propagates: `Design.registry_snapshot_id` →
  `ExperimentSpec` → `run_declared` payload → subject `RunManifest`'s
  `ExperimentBinding` (asserted in `launch_requires_a_live_claim`).

## Acceptance-criteria verdicts

- **AC-R-2.10.3-1** register+expand, typed refusals — MET (refusal
  corpus; deterministic ids).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-2** deterministic expansion, content-addressed plans,
  `n/a{level_ineligible}` cells — MET (expand determinism + plan-doc
  `n/a` cells).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-3** single-worker lifecycle ops — MET (29-test engine
  suite; pause/resume gates).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-4** task-blocked arm-interleaved order, seed
  reproducible — MET (`interleaved_order_is_task_blocked_arm_interleaved`;
  keys derived under `experiment.order.*` domains).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-5** exactly-once settlement + recovery — MET
  (`settle_is_exactly_once`, KP-E1…E5 battery, lease-fence attach).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-6** re-attempt discipline — MET (infra ⇒
  `settled`→`excluded`→`replanned` at `attempt_no+1` same seed material;
  `oracle_failure` ⇒ regrade marker, never re-run; `scored` never
  re-attempted).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-7** matched-budget enforcement at the four points — MET
  (E-1 register checks incl. enforcement/`budget_relevant` coverage;
  E-2 launch `InsufficientBudget` replannable; E-3 settle/close
  utilisation records + `under_utilised`; E-4 close re-check).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-8** `exploratory` admission — MET (kind table exempts
  pre-registration/match members; refusal corpus covers it).
- **AC-R-2.10.3-9** — PARTIAL/DEFERRED under ADR-0213 (OQ-363): the
  `iso_cost` companion runs as distinct subject runs; run-sharing across
  MatchSpecs awaits the OQ-363 ruling.
- **AC-R-2.10.2-6** registry never model-facing — MET (`C-LCD-5` static
  refusal + catalog-bound-tool negative test).
- **AC-R-2.10.2-12** `slot_choices`/`param_schema`/`budget_relevant`
  coverage — MET (registry `slot_choices` enumerates the compaction
  variants with typed domains and `budget_relevant` flags — landed in
  S3.3's corpus; this ticket adds the differing-parameter coverage
  refusal at register).
